h: Atiku's camp hits back at Shettima over a remark about a Kano school
p: Atiku Abubakar's camp has reportedly replied to Vice President Kashim Shettima after a remark about a Kano school that drew online reaction. The camp is said to have questioned the educational record of President Tinubu in return. The exchange adds to the sharp tone of the early 2027 campaign.
more: Supporters of both sides have joined the exchange on social media.
The campaigns are yet to issue any further statement.
